title: Reproduction in Animals
summary: Sexual and asexual reproduction, internal and external fertilisation, eggs or live young, and metamorphosis.

ib.note: Gametes and meiosis are formalised in MYP 5 / CBSE 10

cbse.chapter: Earlier NCERT Ch 9: Reproduction in Animals

objectives: I can describe sexual reproduction as the fusion of male and female gametes to form a zygote.
I can distinguish internal and external fertilisation, and oviparous and viviparous animals.
I can describe metamorphosis in frogs and insects.
misconceptions: Asexual reproduction only happens in plants.
